observations.title: Dangerous node self-disclosure and gating
observations.technical_explanation: The node definition sets isDangerous to true and the project documentation describes an Allow Dangerous toggle that must be enabled per flow before dangerous nodes execute. This disclosure and gating align the dynamic execution capability with the extension's stated purpose and reduce the likelihood of accidental execution of user-authored code.
